verdict.rationale: Sill says it has no account and no server, so screen content and typed input stay on the user's own devices. Its privacy and support docs let users delete stored pairing records: remove paired devices on the Mac, or Forget a paired Mac on the iPhone/iPad. There are no documented retention controls or purge options for logs or other local data. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods, in-product deletion of logs and local data, any statement of what data is stored locally and for how long, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: There is no account and no server: your screen and what you type travel only between your own devices
To forget one Mac you paired, touch and hold its row on the connect screen and choose Forget.
You can remove any of them in Sill’s Settings › Devices on your Mac.
Sill's Settings › Devices on your Mac lists the devices you paired. Remove one you no longer use, or have lost.
